blocks.source: ドラゴンクエスト4
blocks.translation: Dragon Quest IV

blocks.source: FCで発売したDQ4のPS版リメイク。DQ7の後の作品で、グラフィックもDQ7に近いが、様々な箇所が洗練されている。ちなみにDS版リメイクもあるが、そちらは未プレイにつき良く知らない。
blocks.translation: This is the PlayStation remake of DQ4, originally released for the FC. It was made after DQ7, and while its graphics are similar to DQ7's, various aspects have been refined. There is also a DS remake, but I have not played it, so I do not know much about it.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 章形式であり、章毎にそれぞれの個性があるため、飽きずに話を進めることができるのが長所。また、物語はDQ3までの勧善懲悪とは趣が異なる。
blocks.translation: Its chapter-based format, with each chapter having its own distinct character, is a strength that lets you advance the story without getting bored. The story also differs in tone from the classic good-versus-evil approach used up through DQ3.

blocks.source: PS版クリア後の隠し要素は賛否あるかもしれないが、リメイクだからこそできる豪華サービスだともいえる。個人的にはただ難しい/強いだけで大してシナリオに関係の無い裏ダンジョン/裏ボスをやらされるよりは断然良い。
blocks.translation: The hidden elements after clearing the PS version may be controversial, but they can also be called lavish bonuses made possible specifically because this is a remake. Personally, I much prefer them to being forced to tackle a postgame dungeon or boss that is merely difficult or powerful and has little relevance to the story.

blocks.source: DQ7と同じ「はなす」コマンドの逆輸入によって、仲間キャラの個性が強調された。このため、FC版とは比較にならないほどテキスト量が増大している。
blocks.translation: The reintroduction of the “Talk” command from DQ7 further emphasized the personalities of the party members. As a result, the amount of text increased dramatically compared with the FC version.

blocks.source: 実は元々、シリーズの中でも町・ダンジョンの数は多いほうで、DQ3と比較してもかなりボリュームアップされていることがわかる。元がFCなので、さすがにやや短めだが、ゲームテンポがかなり良いにも関わらず30時間程度は十分遊べる。
blocks.translation: In fact, it originally had a relatively large number of towns and dungeons for the series, and even compared with DQ3, it is clear that its volume was greatly expanded. Since it was originally an FC game, it is somewhat short, but despite its very good pace, it still provides around 30 hours of gameplay.

blocks.source: システム
blocks.translation: Systems

blocks.source: DQシリーズで、初の『作戦』が登場した作品。FC版当時は画期的ではあったものの命令ができないため、仲間が思うように行動してくれず不評を浴びることも多かった。だが、PS版では「命令させろ」が追加されたため、その心配はない。また、DQ7と同じく作戦は個別に指定できる。
blocks.translation: This was the first game in the DQ series to introduce “Tactics.” Although it was groundbreaking at the time of the FC version, the inability to issue commands often drew criticism because party members would not act as the player intended. However, the PS version added “Follow Orders,” so that is no longer a concern. As in DQ7, tactics can also be assigned individually.

blocks.source: カジノの登場もこの作品が初出であり、元々はFCとは思えない意欲的な作品だった。当時、DQは『化石』などではなかった。
blocks.translation: This was also the first game in the series to feature a casino, and it was originally an ambitious title that hardly seemed possible on the FC. Back then, DQ was anything but a “fossil.”

blocks.source: リメイクによる追加要素としてDQ7と同じ移民システムが採用されている。個人的には面倒も多いので、そこまで好きではなかったり……。
blocks.translation: As an addition in this remake, it adopts the same immigrant system as DQ7. Personally, I did not like it that much, since it involves quite a bit of tedious work…

blocks.source: バランス
blocks.translation: Balance

blocks.source: 敵の強さは強すぎず、弱すぎずで丁度良い。HPが減ると痛恨を繰り出す大目玉、スライムが合体して登場するキングスライムなど個性も豊かだ。
blocks.translation: The enemies are neither too strong nor too weak—they are just right. There is also plenty of variety, from Big Eye, which unleashes critical hits when its HP is low, to King Slime, which appears after Slimes merge together.

blocks.source: SFC版DQ3では強力な全体攻撃武器などの登場で難易度が大幅に下がったが、こちらについてはそれほどの難易度低下はない。
blocks.translation: In the SFC version of DQ3, the introduction of powerful weapons capable of attacking all enemies greatly reduced the difficulty, but the difficulty here has not been lowered to the same extent.

blocks.source: 仲間の強さのバランスは元のFC版の個性を受け継いでいるせいで、崩れている部分もあるが、個人的にはこれぐらいの極端さは愛嬌だと思っている。また、クリア後に仲間になる某キャラクターは裏の主人公なのだから、強くて当然。ミネアやトルネコなどの使いにくかったキャラクターはそれなりに強化されている。
blocks.translation: The balance between the party members' strengths is somewhat uneven because it inherits the original FC version's distinct character traits, but personally, I think this degree of extremity is part of its charm. Also, the character who joins the party after clearing the game is the hidden protagonist, so naturally they are powerful. Characters who were difficult to use, such as Meena and Torneko, have been strengthened to a reasonable degree.

blocks.source: 「章の切替」「イベント構成」「仲間の登場時期」「店の値段」「宝箱の配置」「魔物の個性」などなど、それぞれの要素が絶妙に調整されており、クリアまで飽きさせない構成になっている。個人的にはDQシリーズで最もバランスが良いのは、現状この作品だと思っている。
blocks.translation: The various elements, such as “chapter transitions,” “event structure,” “when party members appear,” “shop prices,” “chest placement,” and “monster individuality,” have all been exquisitely adjusted, creating a structure that keeps you from getting bored until the end. Personally, I currently consider this to be the best-balanced game in the DQ series.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘や場所移動の切り替え時間はFC･SFC時代のDQと同等以上なので、ストレスはほとんどない。
blocks.translation: The transition times for battles and moving between locations are at least as good as those in FC and SFC-era DQ games, so there is very little frustration.

blocks.source: 戦闘テンポもアニメーションのタイミングが調整されており意外にも、SFCのDQ3･6より高速化されている。
blocks.translation: The battle pace has also been improved by adjusting the timing of the animations, and is surprisingly faster than in the SFC versions of DQ3 and DQ6.

blocks.source: （SFCの敵の攻撃はなぜか「攻撃アニメ→攻撃音→ダメージ表示」の順番なのでテンポが悪い。PSDQ4では攻撃アニメと同時に攻撃音が鳴る。）
blocks.translation: (For some reason, enemy attacks in the SFC versions follow the order “attack animation → attack sound → damage display,” which makes the pace feel sluggish. In PS DQ4, the attack sound plays simultaneously with the attack animation.)

blocks.source: 全体的にシステムに無駄がないため、戸惑うことも少ない。
blocks.translation: Overall, the systems contain little unnecessary fuss, so there are few occasions for confusion.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: DQ7よりも、さらにモンスターが良く動く。ドット絵アニメーションは芸術的。FC当時もラスボスの変身シーンは圧巻だったが、PS版でも強化されている。
blocks.translation: The monsters move even better than they do in DQ7. The pixel-art animations are artistic. The final boss's transformation scene was already spectacular on the FC, but it has been enhanced in the PS version as well.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 曲の種類の豊富さと、質の高さの双方で、シリーズ中でも、最も曲が良いと思う。特に通常戦闘曲は名曲。章ごとに変化するフィールド曲はいずれも質が高い。
blocks.translation: In terms of both the variety and the high quality of its songs, I think it has the best music in the series. The regular battle theme in particular is a masterpiece. All of the field themes, which change with each chapter, are high quality.

blocks.source: ただし、新しく追加された曲は正直微妙かも。中ボス戦とか、某キャラクターのテーマ曲とか、既存の曲にはかなり見劣りする。
blocks.translation: However, the newly added songs are honestly rather underwhelming. The mid-boss battle theme and a certain character's theme, for example, compare quite unfavorably with the existing music.
